blurb: Schwartz Sports Massage offers personalized sports massage and bodywork including deep tissue massage, myofascial release, strain counterstrain, trigger point therapy, and lymphatic drainage. Treatments focus on recovery, injury prevention, and performance enhancement. Sessions include assessment, targeted techniques, and expert advice on wellness and corrective exercises.
